description: Read the spreads (Druckbögen) of an open document or of an .idml/.indd file as a layout description (JSON): per spread the page names, parent page prefixes (Musterseiten), page margins and every object with type, page, x, y, width, height in mm from the top left corner of its page, rotation, layer, object style, fill, text wrap, text frame options and threading order (chain_index); images and PDFs with file path, scale, offset and graphic bounds; texts as paragraph lists with paragraph and character styles and local formatting (Laufweite and other overrides, which the line breaks depend on). Groups, lines, ellipses, rotated objects and stories with tables or anchored objects are kept as unchanged IDML (type raw, raw_xml). The result can be passed to build_issue or build_snippet unchanged. Pass output_path to write the JSON to a file; the answer then carries the counts only (include_layout true adds the layout). Read-only for the document.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used.

include_layout.description: Return the layout in the answer. Default true without output_path, false with it.

output_path.description: Write the layout description to this .json file.

pages.description: Only the spreads containing these pages (page names as printed, e.g. ["32"]). Default: all spreads.

path.description: An .idml, .indd or .indt file to read instead of an open document. An .indd/.indt is opened as an invisible copy and closed again.

name: read_layout
title: Read a layout description
